controlSql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS telemetry_routes (key_id CHAR(36) PRIMARY KEY,company_id CHAR(36) NOT NULL,source_id CHAR(36) NOT NULL,secret_hash CHAR(64) NOT NULL,active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,credential_revision INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,created_at TIMESTAMP(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),INDEX(company_id,source_id),FOREIGN KEY(company_id) REFERENCES company_accounts(id)) ENGINE=InnoDB

CREATE OR REPLACE SQL SECURITY DEFINER VIEW telemetry_worker_routes AS SELECT r.key_id,r.company_id,r.source_id,r.secret_hash,r.credential_revision,t.database_name,t.secret_ref AS tenant_vault_ref FROM telemetry_routes r JOIN company_accounts c ON c.id=r.company_id JOIN tenant_storage t ON t.company_id=c.id WHERE r.active=1 AND c.status='active' AND c.suspended=0 AND t.status='ready'
tenantSql: ALTER TABLE tenant_metadata ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS minimum_runtime_schema INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 10
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS telemetry_component (id TINYINT PRIMARY KEY CHECK(id=1),schema_version INT NOT NULL,contract_version VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL) ENGINE=InnoDB
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS telemetry_clock (id TINYINT PRIMARY KEY CHECK(id=1),revision BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0) ENGINE=InnoDB

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS telemetry_sources (id CHAR(36) PRIMARY KEY,name VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL,kind VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL,transport VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL,status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL,source_mode VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL,config_revision INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,credential_revision INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,created_by CHAR(36) NOT NULL,created_at TIMESTAMP(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) ENGINE=InnoDB

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS telemetry_signals (id CHAR(36) PRIMARY KEY,source_id CHAR(36) NOT NULL,signal_key VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,title VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL,status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL,current_definition_revision INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,version INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,created_at TIMESTAMP(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),UNIQUE(source_id,signal_key),FOREIGN KEY(source_id) REFERENCES telemetry_sources(id)) ENGINE=InnoDB

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS telemetry_signal_definitions (signal_id CHAR(36) NOT NULL,revision INT NOT NULL,value_type VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL,measurement VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL,unit VARCHAR(24) NULL,interval_ms INT NULL,semantic_hint VARCHAR(64) NULL,created_at TIMESTAMP(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),PRIMARY KEY(signal_id,revision),FOREIGN KEY(signal_id) REFERENCES telemetry_signals(id)) ENGINE=InnoDB

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS telemetry_source_configs (source_id CHAR(36) NOT NULL,revision INT NOT NULL,config_json LONGTEXT NOT NULL CHECK(JSON_VALID(config_json)),created_by CHAR(36) NOT NULL,created_at TIMESTAMP(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),PRIMARY KEY(source_id,revision),FOREIGN KEY(source_id) REFERENCES telemetry_sources(id)) ENGINE=InnoDB

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS telemetry_ingestions (receipt_id CHAR(36) PRIMARY KEY,source_id CHAR(36) NOT NULL,batch_id VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,received_at_ms BIGINT NOT NULL,payload_hash CHAR(64) NOT NULL,receipt_json LONGTEXT NOT NULL CHECK(JSON_VALID(receipt_json)),UNIQUE(source_id,batch_id),FOREIGN KEY(source_id) REFERENCES telemetry_sources(id)) ENGINE=InnoDB

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS telemetry_samples (sample_id CHAR(36) PRIMARY KEY,signal_id CHAR(36) NOT NULL,definition_revision INT NOT NULL,source_event_id VARCHAR(160) NULL,event_time_ms BIGINT NOT NULL,period_end_ms BIGINT NULL,value_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(JSON_VALID(value_json)),received_at_ms BIGINT NOT NULL,content_hash CHAR(64) NOT NULL,identity_hash CHAR(64) NOT NULL,receipt_id CHAR(36) NOT NULL,UNIQUE(signal_id,identity_hash),UNIQUE(signal_id,event_time_ms,period_end_ms),INDEX(signal_id,event_time_ms,sample_id),FOREIGN KEY(signal_id,definition_revision) REFERENCES telemetry_signal_definitions(signal_id,revision),FOREIGN KEY(receipt_id) REFERENCES telemetry_ingestions(receipt_id)) ENGINE=InnoDB

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS telemetry_conflicts (id CHAR(36) PRIMARY KEY,sample_id CHAR(36) NOT NULL,receipt_id CHAR(36) NOT NULL,incoming_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(JSON_VALID(incoming_json)),received_at_ms BIGINT NOT NULL,INDEX(sample_id),FOREIGN KEY(sample_id) REFERENCES telemetry_samples(sample_id),FOREIGN KEY(receipt_id) REFERENCES telemetry_ingestions(receipt_id)) ENGINE=InnoDB

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS telemetry_receipt_rows (receipt_id CHAR(36) NOT NULL,row_index INT NOT NULL,signal_id CHAR(36) NULL,sample_id CHAR(36) NULL,status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL,code VARCHAR(80) NULL,PRIMARY KEY(receipt_id,row_index),FOREIGN KEY(receipt_id) REFERENCES telemetry_ingestions(receipt_id)) ENGINE=InnoDB

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS telemetry_runtime_status (source_id CHAR(36) PRIMARY KEY,last_contact_ms BIGINT NULL,last_sample_ms BIGINT NULL,reported_config_revision INT NULL,last_error VARCHAR(80) NULL,worker_id VARCHAR(80) NULL,heartbeat_ms BIGINT NULL,FOREIGN KEY(source_id) REFERENCES telemetry_sources(id)) ENGINE=InnoDB

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS telemetry_changes (sequence BIGINT PRIMARY KEY,entity_id CHAR(36) NOT NULL,entity_type VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL,entity_revision BIGINT NOT NULL,change_kind VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL,changed_at_ms BIGINT NOT NULL,INDEX(entity_type,entity_id,sequence)) ENGINE=InnoDB

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS telemetry_input_bindings (id CHAR(36) PRIMARY KEY,version INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,signal_id CHAR(36) NOT NULL,consumer VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL,input_key VARCHAR(48) NOT NULL,resource_id CHAR(36) NOT NULL,valid_from BIGINT NOT NULL,valid_to BIGINT NULL,enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,created_by CHAR(36) NOT NULL,created_at TIMESTAMP(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),INDEX(resource_id,consumer,input_key,valid_from),INDEX(signal_id,valid_from),FOREIGN KEY(signal_id) REFERENCES telemetry_signals(id),FOREIGN KEY(resource_id) REFERENCES resources(id)) ENGINE=InnoDB

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS telemetry_count_claims (sample_id CHAR(36) PRIMARY KEY,report_id CHAR(36) NOT NULL,line_position INT NOT NULL,resource_id CHAR(36) NOT NULL,input_key VARCHAR(48) NOT NULL,period_start BIGINT NOT NULL,INDEX(resource_id,input_key,period_start),FOREIGN KEY(sample_id) REFERENCES telemetry_samples(sample_id),FOREIGN KEY(report_id) REFERENCES production_reports(id)) ENGINE=InnoDB

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS telemetry_commands (id CHAR(36) PRIMARY KEY,source_id CHAR(36) NOT NULL,method VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,params_json TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(JSON_VALID(params_json)),state VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL,expires_at_ms BIGINT NOT NULL,attempts INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,next_at_ms BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,result_json TEXT NULL,created_by CHAR(36) NOT NULL,created_at TIMESTAMP(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3),FOREIGN KEY(source_id) REFERENCES telemetry_sources(id)) ENGINE=InnoDB
